title: [codex] Lower delayed-cover root and recursive shape production to fixed tapes
body:
## Result

This implements the delayed-cover root and recursive shape interfaces as one literal fixed-tape program. The previous one-edge composition received H and root A/R; the new path starts those fields blank and generates them from physical positive binary T, R_body and width w plus unary depth d:

```
H=q^(N*N*(w-1)), A0=T*(L*H)^d, R0=H*R_body
A_child=A_parent/(L*H), R_child=H*R_parent
```

Every child generates its own next grants from its actual live frame before suspension. One finite PC/table runs split, two statically named child sites, physical CALL/RETURN, output protection before destructive pop, and merge at every finite depth. No runtime host arithmetic, decoded descriptor, callback, host recursion or per-depth tape allocation supplies these operations.

For L4/q3/N1, the natural-root table has **31,821 instructions on 27 fixed tapes**, independent of w/d. From T=R_body=1,w2,d2 it physically generates A144/R3/H3 and executes

```
(A,R,V)=(144,3,1728) -> (12,9,432) -> (1,27,108)
```

with seven actual node entries, six complete returns, 1,449,116 microtransitions and 23,807 visited cells. Original input bytes/heads survive. Generated root/child grants, guides, control, relays and scratch are physically erased; erased backing remains charged. The same table runs four natural-root cases. Five actual instruction faults reject, while a stale-H fault passes one edge and fails at grandchildren.

`recursion/core/PROOF.md` gives the all-depth whole-high address/return induction and complete occurrence-sum time/geometric active-chain backing bill. `recursion/root/PROOF.md` proves physical root production with a separate O_template(V0) setup/cleanup bound, including d=0. Its repeated products are paid by geometric intermediate growth, not d copies of V0. The actual two-site sum is V0*sum_(j=0..d)(2/L)^j; a different final template retains its own call multiplicity and bill. The isolated router's 94V bound is not assigned to the whole tree.

## Scope and credit

The explicit leaf complements bits. Numerical ancestor weights, ordinary BIT/Gaussian children, outer integer-input production of T/w/depth, final-template routes/fallbacks/stock and precision remain separate obligations. **No new kappa, paid-profile improvement, selected-frontier change or framework-assumption discharge is claimed. Scientific admission remains pending.**

Ali Romman's #5829 supplies whole-high geometry, V/L contraction and allocation lineage; David Arias's #2776 supplies the unchanged finite machine/assembler/counter. Retained stack, codec and protected-return sources keep their original credit. Selected binary-control, R437 and Good/Pair/ancestor arithmetic retain predecessor attribution. Generic multiplication and geometric sums are standard. The new contribution is their source-bound emitted recursive/root connection and its scoped proof/bill; no world-priority claim is made.

The original isolated router, separate interpreters, one-edge composition and shape producer remain exact scientific stages. The new core/root packets preserve complete tables, receipts and FILES manifests, including the root packet's unchanged core. Only two old-core instruction links change in the linked root program. Newly authored recursive/root code is explicitly distinguished from the eight actual retained 3bad tree inputs; no historical pin is fabricated for new code.

`recursion/REVIEW.json` summarizes separate **author-side** static/source/proof reviews with targeted controls. The new recursion is not claimed to have a separately written runtime interpreter; old independent-walker coverage stays within its original scopes. A frozen historical pending-review field is preserved and explained by the later summary. These reviews are not external scientific acceptance.

## Reproduction and validation

Python3.12, standard library only:

```
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/delayed-cover-physical-batch-routing
```

Eight registered commands execute **fourteen scientific replays** in normal and optimized modes. The original six commands are unchanged; each shape driver retains its two old checks, then authenticates and runs the recursive core and natural-root checks. The declared total timeout remains 480 seconds. No shared workflow limit is changed.

Exact head `e4e52d6ba2c805fa78bb57778c3b7bbc064edba5` passed a Git-free export of all147 committed files: all eight commands/fourteen replays in13.678s, external cwd, empty PATH, files0444/directories0555, every input byte unchanged after every command. Committed bytes and executable modes pass the publication preflight. All38 source refs/paths/blobs/SHA values and their raw parent-edge reachability were checked directly; the optional full-history helper is unavailable locally in the shallow checkout and is not claimed to have run. Hosted CI for this new head is pending.

Finite executions corroborate the written proofs; they do not prove the entire multiplication theorem. Historical native/supplier, Lean and Docker suites were not rerun. Prepared for thu-nmrc with substantial OpenAI Codex and parallel-agent assistance; original notices remain exact, Apache-2.0. Intended lane: scoped validated research.
